entities.summary: The Rudolfinum is a building in Prague, Czech Republic. It is designed in the neo-Renaissance style and is situated on Jan Palach Square on the bank of the river Vltava. Since its opening in 1885, it has been associated with music and art. Rudolfinum is a event venue in Europe, established in 1876. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
